# Deterministic content hashing

content_hash computes a deterministic SHA-256 over canonical JSON produced by json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).

Provide a stable, deterministic identifier for payloads (envelope identity) across runs and environments.
